en: Instead of casting a wistful glance backward at all the species we've left in the dust IQ-wise, it implicitly asks what the real costs of our own intelligence might be.
zh: 这项研究不再带着自得回望那些在智力上被我们远远甩在身后的物种，而是含蓄地追问：人类自身的智力究竟付出了什么真实代价。

en: Every cat with an owner, for instance, is running a small-scale study in operant conditioning.
zh: 比如，每一只有主人的猫，其实都像是在进行一项小规模的操作性条件反射研究。

meaning: a. 非决定性的；无效果的
en: So far the results are inconclusive.
zh: 到目前为止，结果仍然没有定论。

meaning: a. 缺乏考虑的；无思想的
en: "Not choice, but habit rules the unreflecting herd," William Wordsworth said in the 19th century.
zh: 19世纪，威廉·华兹华斯曾说：“支配不加反思的人群的不是选择，而是习惯。”

en: In the ever-changing 21st century, even the word “habit” carries a negative implication.
zh: 在不断变化的21世纪，甚至“习惯”这个词本身也带有负面意味。

en: But brain researchers have discovered that when we consciously develop new habits, we create parallel paths, and even entirely new brain cells, that can jump our trains of thought onto new, innovative tracks.
zh: 但脑科学研究者发现，当我们有意识地培养新习惯时，会形成平行路径，甚至生成全新的脑细胞，从而让思维列车跃迁到新的、富有创新性的轨道上。

meaning: a. 不变的；不能改变的
en: Rather than dismissing ourselves as unchangeable creatures of habit, we can instead direct our own change by consciously developing new habits.
zh: 与其认定自己是无法改变的习惯动物，不如通过有意识地培养新习惯，主动引导自身改变。

en: “The first thing needed for innovation is a fascination with wonder,” says Dawna Markova, author of The Open Mind.
zh: “创新首先需要的是对惊奇保持着迷。”《开放的心智》作者多娜·马尔科娃说。

meaning: a. 革新的；富有革新精神的
en: A good innovational thinker is always exploring the many other possibilities.”
zh: 优秀的创新思考者总是在探索许多其他的可能性。”

en: Researchers in the late 1960s discovered that humans are born with the capacity to approach challenges in four primary ways: analytically, procedurally, relationally (or collaboratively) and innovatively.
zh: 20世纪60年代末的研究者发现，人天生具有以四种基本方式应对挑战的能力：分析式、程序式、关系式（或协作式）和创新式。

en: Among the most popular are paternity and kinship testing, which adopted children can use to find their biological relatives and families can use to track down kids put up for adoption.
zh: 最受欢迎的服务之一是亲子和亲缘关系检测：被收养的孩子可以借此寻找血缘亲属，家庭也可以寻找曾被送养的孩子。

en: DNA testing is also the latest rage among passionate genealogists—and supports businesses that offer to search for a family's geographic roots.
zh: DNA 检测还成了热衷家谱研究者的新潮流，也催生了帮助人们追寻家族地理起源的商业服务。

en: DNA testing is also the latest rage among passionate genealogists—and supports businesses that offer to search for a family's geographic roots.
zh: DNA 检测还成了热衷家谱研究者的新潮流，也催生了帮助人们追寻家族地理起源的商业服务。

en: ‘There's a kind of false precision being hawked by people claiming they are doing ancestry testing,’ says Troy Duster, a New York University sociologist.
zh: 纽约大学社会学家特洛伊·达斯特说：“一些声称从事祖源检测的人正在兜售一种虚假的精确性。”

en: He notes that each individual has many ancestors—numbering in the hundreds just a few centuries back.
zh: 他指出，每个人都有许多祖先；仅仅向前追溯几个世纪，祖先数量就会达到数百人。

en: Yet most ancestry testing only considers a single lineage, either the Y chromosome inherited through men in a father's line or mitochondrial DNA, which is passed down only from mothers.
zh: 然而，大多数祖源检测只考察一条血缘线：要么分析父系男性传递的 Y 染色体，要么分析只由母亲传下来的线粒体 DNA。

meaning: 曾祖父或曾祖母；外曾祖父或外曾祖母
en: This DNA can reveal genetic information about only one or two ancestors, even though, for example, just three generations back people also have six other great-grandparents or, four generations back, 14 other great-great-grandparents.
zh: 这种 DNA 只能揭示一两个祖先的遗传信息；但举例来说，仅向前追溯三代，一个人还会有另外六位曾祖父母，追溯四代则还会有另外14位高祖父母。

en: Critics also argue that commercial genetic testing is only as good as the reference collections to which a sample is compared.
zh: 批评者还指出，商业基因检测的可靠程度取决于用于比对的参考数据库质量。

en: Databases used by some companies don't rely on data collected systematically but rather lump together information from different research projects.
zh: 一些公司使用的数据库并不是建立在系统采集的数据之上，而只是把不同研究项目的信息拼在一起。

en: In addition, the computer programs a company uses to estimate relationships may be patented and not subject to peer review or outside evaluation.
zh: 此外，公司用于推断亲缘关系的计算机程序可能受到专利保护，因此不接受同行评议或外部评价。

en: Progress in both areas is undoubtedly necessary for the social, political, and intellectual development of these and all other societies; however, the conventional view that education should be one of the very highest priorities for promoting rapid economic development in poor countries is wrong.
zh: 这两个领域的进步无疑都是这些国家乃至所有社会实现社会、政治和智力发展的必要条件；然而，把教育视为贫困国家推动快速经济发展的最高优先事项之一，这种传统看法是错误的。

en: We are fortunate that it is, because building new educational systems there and putting enough people through them to improve economic performance would require two or three generations.
zh: 幸好这种看法是错的，因为如果要靠建立新的教育体系，并让足够多的人接受这种教育来改善经济表现，往往需要两三代人的时间。

en: The findings of a research institution have consistently shown that workers in all countries can be trained on the job to achieve radically higher productivity and, as a result, radically higher standards of living.
zh: 一家研究机构的发现一贯表明，各国工人都可以通过在职培训显著提高生产率，并由此大幅提高生活水平。

en: Ironically, the first evidence for this idea appeared in the United States.
zh: 颇具讽刺意味的是，这一观点的第一批证据恰恰出现在美国。

en: Not long ago, with the country entering a recession and Japan at its pre-bubble peak, the U.S. workforce was derided as poorly educated and one of the primary causes of the poor U.S. economic performance.
zh: 不久前，在美国陷入衰退、而日本处于泡沫破裂前的高峰时期，美国劳动力曾因教育水平低而遭到嘲讽，并被视为美国经济表现不佳的主要原因之一。

en: Japan was, and remains, the global leader in automotive-assembly productivity.
zh: 日本当时是、现在仍是汽车装配生产率的全球领先者。

en: Yet the research revealed that the U.S. factories of Honda, Nissan, and Toyota achieved about 95 percent of the productivity of their Japanese counterparts—a result of the training that U.S. workers received on the job.
zh: 然而研究发现，本田、日产和丰田在美国的工厂，其生产率达到了日本同类工厂的大约95%，而这正是在职培训美国工人的结果。

en: More recently, while examining housing construction, the researchers discovered that illiterate, non-English-speaking Mexican workers in Houston, Texas, consistently met best-practice labor productivity standards despite the complexity of the building industry's work.

en: Only when humanity began to get its food in a more productive way was there time for other things.
zh: 只有当人类开始以更高效的方式获取食物之后，才有时间从事其他活动。

en: As education improved, humanity's productivity potential increased as well.
zh: 随着教育改善，人类潜在的生产率也随之提高。

en: A lack of formal education, however, doesn't constrain the ability of the developing world's workforce to substantially improve productivity for the foreseeable future.
zh: 然而，在可预见的未来，正规教育不足并不会限制发展中国家劳动力大幅提高生产率的能力。

zh: 恰恰相反，正是生产率提升受到的限制，解释了为什么这些国家的教育发展没有更快。

en: The most thoroughly studied intellectuals in the history of the New World are the ministers and political leaders of seventeenth-century New England.
zh: 在新大陆历史上，被研究得最为深入的知识分子，是17世纪新英格兰的牧师和政治领袖。

en: According to the standard history of American philosophy, nowhere else in colonial America was ‘so much importance attached to intellectual pursuits.’
zh: 按照美国哲学史的传统叙述，在殖民时期的美洲，没有其他地方像新英格兰这样“如此重视知识追求”。

en: According to many books and articles, New England's leaders established the basic themes and preoccupations of an unfolding, dominant Puritan tradition in American intellectual life.
zh: 许多书籍和文章认为，新英格兰领袖确立了美国思想生活中逐渐展开并占据主导地位的清教传统的基本主题与核心关切。

en: According to many books and articles, New England's leaders established the basic themes and preoccupations of an unfolding, dominant Puritan tradition in American intellectual life.
zh: 许多书籍和文章认为，新英格兰领袖确立了美国思想生活中逐渐展开并占据主导地位的清教传统的基本主题与核心关切。

en: To take this approach to the New Englanders normally means to start with the Puritans' theological innovations and their distinctive ideas about the church—important subjects that we may not neglect.
zh: 按照这种方式研究新英格兰人，通常要从清教徒在神学上的创新以及他们对教会的独特看法谈起——这些当然都是不可忽视的重要主题。

en: But in keeping with our examination of southern intellectual life, we may consider the original Puritans as carriers of European culture, adjusting to New World circumstances.
zh: 但与我们考察南方思想生活的方式一致，我们也可以把最初的清教徒看作欧洲文化的携带者，他们正在适应新大陆的环境。

en: The New England colonies were the scenes of important episodes in the pursuit of widely understood ideals of civility and virtuosity.
zh: 新英格兰殖民地也见证了人们追求广泛认同的文明与才艺理想的重要历程。

zh: 新英格兰殖民地也见证了人们追求广泛认同的文明与才艺理想的重要历程。

en: The early settlers of Massachusetts Bay included men of impressive education and influence in England.
zh: 马萨诸塞湾早期移民中，有一些人在英国就受过良好教育并具有相当影响力。

en: Besides the ninety or so learned ministers who came to Massachusetts churches in the decade after 1629, there were political leaders like John Winthrop, an educated gentleman, lawyer, and official of the Crown before he journeyed to Boston.
zh: 除了1629年后十年间来到马萨诸塞各教会的大约90名博学牧师外，还有约翰·温斯罗普这样的政治领袖；他在前往波士顿之前，是受过教育的绅士、律师和王室官员。

en: These men wrote and published extensively, reaching both New World and Old World audiences, and giving New England an atmosphere of intellectual earnestness.
zh: 这些人大量写作并出版作品，读者遍及新旧大陆，也由此赋予新英格兰一种严肃求知的思想氛围。

en: These men wrote and published extensively, reaching both New World and Old World audiences, and giving New England an atmosphere of intellectual earnestness.
zh: 这些人大量写作并出版作品，读者遍及新旧大陆，也由此赋予新英格兰一种严肃求知的思想氛围。

en: While few craftsmen or farmers, let alone dependents and servants, left literary compositions to be analyzed, it is obvious that their views were less fully intellectualized.
zh: 工匠和农民留下可供分析的文字作品本就不多，更不用说家属和仆人了；显然，他们的观念并没有被充分知识化。

en: One wonders what Dane thought of the careful sermons explaining the Bible that he heard in Puritan churches.
zh: 这不禁让人想知道，戴恩对清教教堂里那些细致解释《圣经》的布道究竟作何感想。

en: Meanwhile, many settlers had slighter religious commitments than Dane's, as one clergyman learned in confronting folk along the coast who mocked that they had not come to the New World for religion.
zh: 与此同时，许多移民的宗教投入甚至还不如戴恩；一位牧师在面对沿海居民时就发现，有人嘲讽说他们来到新大陆并不是为了宗教。

en: Coinciding with the groundbreaking theory of biological evolution proposed by British naturalist Charles Darwin in the 1860s, British social philosopher Herbert Spencer put forward his own theory of biological and cultural evolution.
zh: 19世纪60年代，英国博物学家查尔斯·达尔文提出了开创性的生物进化论；几乎与此同时，英国社会哲学家赫伯特·斯宾塞也提出了自己的生物与文化进化理论。

en: Coinciding with the groundbreaking theory of biological evolution proposed by British naturalist Charles Darwin in the 1860s, British social philosopher Herbert Spencer put forward his own theory of biological and cultural evolution.
zh: 19世纪60年代，英国博物学家查尔斯·达尔文提出了开创性的生物进化论；几乎与此同时，英国社会哲学家赫伯特·斯宾塞也提出了自己的生物与文化进化理论。

en: Spencer argued that all worldly phenomena, including human societies, changed over time, advancing toward perfection.
zh: 斯宾塞认为，世间一切现象——包括人类社会——都会随时间变化，并朝着更加完善的方向发展。

meaning: t. 描绘...的特性；刻划...的性格
en: He argued that human evolution was characterized by a struggle he called the ‘survival of the fittest,’ in which weaker races and societies must eventually be replaced by stronger, more advanced races and societies.
zh: 他认为，人类进化具有一种他称为“适者生存”的斗争特征，在这一过程中，较弱的种族和社会最终必然会被更强大、更先进的种族和社会取代。

en: Morgan helped found modern anthropology—the scientific study of human societies, customs and beliefs—thus becoming one of the earliest anthropologists.
zh: 摩尔根参与奠定了现代人类学——即对人类社会、习俗和信仰进行科学研究的学科——因此成为最早的人类学家之一。

meaning: 完全忠于一种理论；特殊神宠论
en: In the early 1900s in North America, German-born American anthropologist Franz Boas developed a new theory of culture known as historical particularism.
zh: 20世纪初，在北美，出生于德国的美国人类学家弗朗茨·博厄斯提出了一种新的文化理论，称为历史特殊论。

meaning: 完全忠于一种理论；特殊神宠论
en: Historical particularism, which emphasized the uniqueness of all cultures, gave new direction to anthropology.
zh: 历史特殊论强调每一种文化的独特性，为人类学提供了新的研究方向。

en: Historical particularism, which emphasized the uniqueness of all cultures, gave new direction to anthropology.
zh: 历史特殊论强调每一种文化的独特性，为人类学提供了新的研究方向。

en: Boas felt that the culture of any society must be understood as the result of a unique history and not as one of many cultures belonging to a broader evolutionary stage or type of culture.
zh: 博厄斯认为，任何社会的文化都必须被理解为一段独特历史的产物，而不能仅仅把它视作属于某个更广泛进化阶段或文化类型的众多文化之一。

en: This theory was known as diffusionism.
zh: 这种理论被称为传播论。

meaning: 完全忠于一种理论；特殊神宠论
en: Historical particularism became a dominant approach to the study of culture in American anthropology, largely through the influence of many students of Boas.
zh: 在博厄斯众多学生的影响下，历史特殊论后来成为美国人类学研究文化的主导方法。

en: Historical particularism became a dominant approach to the study of culture in American anthropology, largely through the influence of many students of Boas.
zh: 在博厄斯众多学生的影响下，历史特殊论后来成为美国人类学研究文化的主导方法。

en: But a number of anthropologists in the early 1900s also rejected the particularist theory of culture in favor of diffusionism.
zh: 但20世纪初，也有一些人类学家拒绝文化特殊论，转而支持传播论。

en: But a number of anthropologists in the early 1900s also rejected the particularist theory of culture in favor of diffusionism.
zh: 但20世纪初，也有一些人类学家拒绝文化特殊论，转而支持传播论。

en: Some attributed virtually every important cultural achievement to the inventions of a few, especially gifted peoples that, according to diffusionists, then spread to other cultures.
zh: 有些人几乎把所有重要文化成就都归因于少数特别有天赋的民族所作的发明；按照传播论者的说法，这些发明随后传播到了其他文化。

en: For example, British anthropologists Grafton Elliot Smith and W. J. Perry incorrectly suggested, on the basis of inadequate information, that farming, pottery making, and metallurgy all originated in ancient Egypt and diffused throughout the world.
zh: 例如，英国人类学家格拉夫顿·埃利奥特·史密斯和 W. J. 佩里基于不充分的信息，错误地提出农业、制陶和冶金都起源于古埃及，并从那里传播到世界各地。

en: For example, British anthropologists Grafton Elliot Smith and W. J. Perry incorrectly suggested, on the basis of inadequate information, that farming, pottery making, and metallurgy all originated in ancient Egypt and diffused throughout the world.
zh: 例如，英国人类学家格拉夫顿·埃利奥特·史密斯和 W. J. 佩里基于不充分的信息，错误地提出农业、制陶和冶金都起源于古埃及，并从那里传播到世界各地。

en: Durkheim proposed that religious beliefs functioned to reinforce social solidarity.
zh: 涂尔干提出，宗教信仰具有强化社会团结的功能。

en: An interest in the relationship between the function of society and culture became a major theme in European, and especially British, anthropology.
zh: 对社会与文化功能之间关系的关注，后来成为欧洲人类学、尤其是英国人类学的重要主题。

en: Only gradually was the by-product of the institution noted, and only more gradually still was this effect considered as a directive factor in the conduct of the institution.
zh: 人们只是逐渐注意到这种制度所产生的副作用，而又过了更长时间，才把这种作用视为指导制度运行的一个因素。
